summary: AISDLC-676: how should the CI verifier's reviewer-coverage check treat staged-review leaves?

options.description: Verifier counts a Merkle-proved staged-review synthesize leaf (plus security-reviewer) as covering correctness (kind two) and code+test (kind three). Loosens a trust-chain acceptance rule; needs a verifier test with a staged leaf set.
Selection runs the staged pipeline BESIDE code-reviewer and test-reviewer (staged becomes comparison-only); verifier unchanged. Tightening; staged no longer replaces them.
Keep staged selectable in config but refuse it at selection (fall back to three with a logged reason) until one of the other options lands as a follow-up task. Tightening; feature stays dark.

body:
taskId: AISDLC-676
sourceWorktree: /Users/dominique/Documents/dev/ai-sdlc/ai-sdlc/.worktrees/aisdlc-676

PR #1360 (branch ai-sdlc/aisdlc-676-rfc-0052-...). After the rebase onto AISDLC-722/723 main, enforceReviewScope in pipeline-cli/attestation-core/verify-core.mjs re-derives the required reviewer kind from the diff and checkReviewerKindCoverage (review-scope-core.mjs:355) requires correctness-reviewer or code-reviewer+test-reviewer (both for three). CORRECTNESS_NAMES/CODE_NAMES/TEST_NAMES do not contain staged-review, so every staged run's envelope is rejected as 'reviewer set incomplete'. Confirmed independently by the final-round code-reviewer (major) and security-reviewer (minor). Nothing is broken today: no repo config selects staged. Verifier acceptance is a trust-chain surface, so this executor did not change it. All other round-2 findings are fixed and pushed (da36cefe); test and security reviewers approved, code reviewer blocks only on this.
